fields.name: name
fields.description: The character of a friend that logged in.

fields.name: server
fields.description: The server of that character: the region and the server name, for example `"EU I"` or `"US PVP"`.

senders.what: `notify_friends_emit`. The login server runs `notify_friends` (shared code in adventure_functions.js). It runs this function on each server that has online friends, through `server_eval_safe`.
The login of a character (the `auth` handler) calls `notify_friends`, when the account has friends and the character is not private.
`notify_friends`: it finds the online characters whose friend list has the account.
